title: Quotients of graded quasi-Hopf algebras
summary: We classify the quasi-Hopf ideals of quasi-Hopf algebras faithfully graded by arbitrary groups. Each ideal determines a normal subgroup, recording which degrees are identified in the quotient, together with an invariant ideal in the corresponding neutral component. We refine this description using an ideal of the original neutral component and a retraction of a naturally associated intermediate quotient. We prove that this intermediate quotient splits as the tensor product of its neutral component with the group algebra of the normal subgroup. For fixed subgroup and neutral-component data,…
